answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 903 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: One of my friend told me that his doing masturbate since longtime in a week 2 to 3time still his single and not yet married and age is 30 years. since longtime he try to stop this. but he failed to doing masterbate. so what he ill do now to stop. Question: One of my friend told me that his doing masturbate since longtime in a week 2 to 3time still his single and not yet married and age is 30 years. since longtime he try to stop this. but he failed to doing masterbate. so what he ill do now to stop. Answer ID: 903 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 346/346=L) The best solution for him is to marry. If it is difficult then he should keep fast as much as possible. It is narrated in Hadith: یا معشر الشباب! من استطاع منکم الباءة فلیتزوج، فانہ اغض للبصر و احصن للفرج، ومن لم یستطع منکم فعلیہ بالصوم فانہ لہ وجاء (مشکوة: 2/267) Also, he should resolve to refrain from acts that cause indecent feelings like gazing women, looking at obscene pictures and so on. If he feels tempted to sin he should visualize the punishment of Allah and fatal diseases. Moreover, in case of committing sinful acts he should bind himself to do any difficult task like offering hundred rakat nafl or charity of some amount. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
